validation_rules: Patient resources must include non-null fields for id, name[0].family, gender, and birthDate.
Patient.gender must be one of the exact allowed values: 'male', 'female', 'other', 'unknown'.
Patient.birthDate must follow ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD.
Encounter resources must include non-null fields for id, status, period.start, and subject.reference.
Encounter.status must be one of the exact allowed values: 'planned', 'in-progress', 'finished', 'cancelled'.
Encounter.period.start and period.end (if present) must follow ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.
Observation resources must include non-null fields for id, status, code.coding[0].code, subject.reference, effectiveDateTime, valueQuantity.value, and valueQuantity.unit.
Observation.status must be set to 'final' (or one of 'final', 'preliminary', 'amended').
Observation.valueQuantity.value must be a valid numeric float parsed from result_value string.
Observation.effectiveDateTime must follow ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.
All target records must contain 'resourceType' and a valid 'id' prefixed from the source system identifier.
Any record failing field presence, enumeration, date format, or numeric validation must be rejected and logged completely without partial mapping or guessing.
